proposals.before: Near river transport routes, commoners are registered for labor — in tattered clothes and worn shoes, strength exhausted and sinews weary — while work rations may be swallowed in the middle.

proposals.before: The emperor ordered specific facts; Hongru again said: "I am registered in Qian'an. Under the Ming, poll silver was two qian for lowest-lower land, four qian for lower-middle land, and a little over seven fen per mu for upper land.
